summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3 HRMS features: Organization Details setup and Statutory Compliance Master. All backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend testing successful with all major features functional. Authentication, role-based access control, and integration between frontend and backend working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor overlay interception when multiple dialogs are open simultaneously

Company info form saves data successfully
Location creation works via dialog form
Employee grades pre-populated with default values (Unskilled, Semi-skilled, Skilled, Highly Skilled)
